name: table
description: A list of metrics with a colored header, sorting, row highlighting and optional mini bars, like the process list of htop.

config.name: rows
config.label: Rows
config.description: One row per metric

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The metric to display in this row

config.name: label
config.label: Label
config.description: The name of the row. Defaults to the metric name

config.name: header_name
config.label: Name Header
config.description: The header of the name column. Defaults to NAME

config.name: header_value
config.label: Value Header
config.description: The header of the value column. Defaults to VALUE

config.name: hide_header
config.label: Hide Header
config.description: Hides the header line

config.name: sort
config.label: Sort
config.description: Sorts the rows by their numeric value. Rows without a numeric value go last

config.name: limit
config.label: Max Rows
config.description: Shows only the first rows after sorting. Leave empty to show all rows

config.name: highlight_row
config.label: Highlight Row
config.description: Highlights the row at this position like the htop cursor, e.g. 1 for the top row. Leave empty to highlight nothing

config.name: show_bar
config.label: Show Bars
config.description: Shows a btop style mini bar in front of each value

config.name: bar_width
config.label: Bar Width
config.description: The width of the mini bars in characters. Defaults to 10

config.name: hide_unit
config.label: Hide Unit
config.description: Shows the values without their units

config.name: precision
config.label: Precision
config.description: The number of decimal places. If not set, it is chosen based on the value

config.name: max
config.label: Max Value
config.description: The value of a full mini bar. If not set, percentages use 100 and other metrics use their highest recorded value

config.name: font
config.label: Font
config.description: Use a monospace font for the best result. Defaults to Cascadia Mono, Consolas or the system monospace font

config.name: font_size
config.label: Font Size
config.description: The font size in pixels. The widget width decides how many characters fit

config.name: theme
config.label: Theme
config.description: Color uses the htop and btop palette. Monochrome draws everything in one text color with reverse video headers, like plain top. Colors you set yourself are kept

config.name: text_color
config.label: Names
config.description: The color of the row names

config.name: value_color
config.label: Values
config.description: The color of the values

config.name: header_text_color
config.label: Header Text
config.description: The text color of the header

config.name: header_background_color
config.label: Header Background
config.description: The background color of the header

config.name: highlight_text_color
config.label: Highlight Text
config.description: The text color of the highlighted row

config.name: highlight_background_color
config.label: Highlight Background
config.description: The background color of the highlighted row

config.name: background_color
config.label: Background
config.description: The background color of the widget

config.name: empty_color
config.label: Empty
config.description: The color of the empty squares of the mini bars

config.name: color_mode
config.label: Color Mode
config.description: Gradient colors every cell by its position in the bar, Threshold colors each bar by its current value, Solid always uses the low color

config.name: color
config.label: Low Color
config.description: The color of a low load

config.name: warning_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Percentage of the max value at which the threshold mode switches to the warning color. Defaults to 50

config.name: warning_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The color of a medium load

config.name: critical_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Percentage of the max value at which the threshold mode switches to the critical color. Defaults to 80

config.name: critical_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The color of a high load
